data.name: Playa Los Arcos Hotel Beach Resort & Spa Puerto Vallarta
data.address: Olas Altas 380, Zona Romántica, Emiliano Zapata, 48280 Puerto Vallarta, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
Overlooking Bahía de Banderas, this relaxed hotel is 1 km from a malecón, a paved waterside walkway, and 10 km from Licenciado Gustavo Díaz Ordaz International Airport.
Featuring colonial, hacienda-style decor and carved wood furnishings, the rooms come with flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi, safes, and balconies or terraces, some with bay views. Suites add kitchenettes, and living rooms with sofas. Room service is available.
Parking is free. Amenities include 3 restaurants, and a bar with live music, as well as 3 outdoor pools - 1 with a poolside bar - and a full-service spa. There's also an activity program.
